parsed.explanation: Thin dossier, so I extrapolated from structural signals. Documented positives are weak: no criminalisation of same-sex conduct (a secondary signal), and no documented trans-specific criminal offence, facility rule or border restriction. Documented negatives: a 2018 foreign-government assessment of hostility toward visible LGBTI people, especially in the capital; a 2019 death of an LGBTQ advocacy leader with cause unresolved; and camp harassment dated 2010. Recourse is thin: no gender-identity anti-discrimination or hate-crime law, and the judiciary is not documented as a protection avenue. The 2017 bills are pending, not in force, and are resident-facing. Border, document and custody practice are unrecorded, which is an open question, not an exposure. Net: tier-3 societal hostility with thin recourse, placing the jurisdiction in the Elevated band.
